name: sol_am_pma_1
description: Price derived from spot token balance ratio, manipulable via flash loans/donations
question: The source file in `source` computes an asset or share price directly from the current ratio of token balances (or reserves) held by a contract, such as balanceOf(token)/totalSupply or reserveA/reserveB, without using a manipulation-resistant oracle (e.g., Chainlink, TWAP), so an attacker can flash-loan or donate tokens to skew the balance ratio and manipulate the computed price within a single transaction; this excludes prices sourced from Chainlink or other external oracle feeds, and excludes designs that already use time-weighted average prices or checkpointed/cumulative reserves resistant to single-block manipulation.
criteria: A function computes price or exchange rate as balanceOf(tokenA) divided by balanceOf(tokenB) read live from storage
A vault's share price or pricePerShare is computed as totalAssets() balance divided by totalSupply() without time-weighting
A swap or liquidation function calls getReserves() or reserve0/reserve1 directly and uses the ratio as the price without a TWAP
Price calculation reads slot0 sqrtPriceX96 from a pool directly for critical pricing logic instead of a TWAP oracle
